title: Universal treatment outcome
content: A new study demonstrates the treatment was effective for every participant.
explanation: The reference reports improvement in 62%, not every participant.

title: Risk-free product claim
content: Researchers reported that the product is completely risk-free.
explanation: The source explicitly says the product should not be called risk-free.

title: Observational sleep findings
content: In a small observational sample, researchers observed improved sleep scores, without proving causation.
explanation: The source describes an observational improvement without causal proof.

title: Pediatric extrapolation question
content: The research results demonstrate the same benefits in children.
explanation: The supplied clarification states only adults were enrolled and does not permit generalizing to children.

title: Outdated application form
content: For a new application, submit form Q-14 to the state agency.
explanation: The bulletin explicitly retires Q-14 and requires Q-18.

title: Permitted submission channels
content: Qualifying filings in County A may be submitted either on paper or electronically.
explanation: Both channels are explicitly allowed in the guide.

title: Appeal deadline conflict
content: The deadline for category R appeals is 60 calendar days from notice.
explanation: The supplied reference states a 30-day deadline.

title: Guide with missing jurisdiction
content: To start the process, submit the filing electronically. This applies everywhere.
explanation: The editorial policy requires a jurisdiction and reference date, both missing.

title: Arrival form requirements
content: Visitors from Region A no longer need to complete an arrival form before departure.
explanation: The fictional updated notice explicitly requires the form starting November 1.

title: Museum hours discrepancy
content: The museum is open every Monday and closes at 8 PM.
explanation: The source states Monday closure and 5 PM closing on operating days.

title: Unverified restaurant hours
content: A reader reports that the restaurant now closes at 9 PM, rather than 11 PM as listed.
explanation: The only material is a reader report and an unavailable website.

title: Airport shuttle boarding
content: Downtown shuttle pickups are at Terminal 2; Terminal 1 pickups were discontinued.
explanation: The notice supports the Terminal 2 location and discontinued Terminal 1 pickups.

title: Undisclosed paid feature
content: Our editors independently recommend this sponsored service to all readers.
explanation: Metadata identifies paid sponsorship, no editorial independence, and required disclosure.

title: Correction notice included
content: Editor's correction: an earlier version contained an incorrect product specification.
explanation: The passage includes the correction notice required by policy.

title: Signup conversion math
content: The campaign recorded 12,000 visits and 240 signups, a 2% signup rate.
explanation: 240 divided by 12,000 equals 2%, matching the source.

title: Sponsored product without label
content: Our independent product feature examines the latest release; no disclosure is necessary.
explanation: The source identifies paid content requiring a visible sponsorship label.

title: Updated arrival checklist
content: From November 1, 2026, visitors from Region A must complete the digital arrival form before departure.
explanation: The updated notice confirms the new requirement and effective date.

title: Checklist still lists Q-14
content: Checklist for new applicants: complete and send the current Q-14 form.
explanation: The bulletin explicitly retired Q-14 in favor of Q-18 for new applications.

title: Study population caveat
content: This study enrolled adults, and the available results cannot establish whether children would have the same outcomes.
explanation: The clarification states the dataset covers adults only and cannot support child generalization.

title: Labeled sponsored feature
content: Sponsored content: this paid product feature was commissioned by an advertiser and carries a visible sponsorship label.
explanation: The passage includes sponsorship disclosure in line with the brief.
